text:
By Tommy Paradise ,
3 hours ago
Everyone loves going out to in the state of Texas now and again. Some people love to go to fancy eateries, while others like to go to less expensive places to eat. But some cities in the Lone Star State have the best atmosphere for eateries.
How Is A Texas City’s Rating Determined? To find out the answer, we turn to Restaurant Furniture. They looked at reviews for restaurants placed in the top 100 of the 100 most populated cities in the nation. So, the bigger question becomes which Texas cities where the best?
Download the KUSJ Mobile App Now The four categories used are as follows: National rank, percentage of reviews that are positive and mention restaurant atmosphere, positive reviews that mention restaurant atmosphere, and total reviews.
So, What Are The Top Cities For Restaurant Atmosphere In Texas? With the data provided by Restaurant Furniture, there was a top ten determined. Which cities topped the list? Here’s what was discovered.
All data has been provided by Restaurant Furniture.
These Ten Texas Cities Have The Best Dining Atmospheres Some Texas cities have a better restaurant atmosphere than others. A study ranked the top cities based on positive reviews mentioning atmosphere. Here's a look at Texas eateries with over 100 locations- some with over 1000! Gallery Credit: Renee Raven https://torchystacos.com/ #10 (Tie) Torchy's Tacos: 120 Locations Torchy's Tacos is a true Texas success story- founded in Austin as a taco truck. Torchy's specializes in unique flavors of tacos made fresh-to-order, incredible queso, and fresh squeezed margaritas. https://mrgattispizza.com/ #10 (Tie) Mr. Gatti's Pizza: 120 Locations Mr. Gatti's was founded in Austin in the late 1960s, and has provided pizza and plenty of childhood fun ever since. Between the buffet full of fun food favorites and a killer game room, Mr. Gattis has been the place to have your birthday party for generations. https://www.tacocabana.com/ #9 Taco Cabana: 151 Locations Taco Cabana began modestly in San Antonio, when the concept began in an old Dairy Queen building. Taco Cabana is known for its signature pink restaurants, great patio seating and late open hours. https://www.jasonsdeli.com/ #8 Jason's Deli: 250 Locations Jason's Deli began in the 1970s in Beaumont, Texas. Jason's Deli is known for using healthy, fresh ingredients without MSG or trans fats, and is a gluten-free friendly restaurant. And don't get me started on the amazing slad bar. https://shipleydonuts.com/ #7 Shipley's Do-Nuts: 374 Locations Shipley's Do-Nuts has a long history here in Texas, with the first location opening in 1936 in Houston. Shipley's is known for their fresh donuts, particularly the cherry iced one (my favorite), pastries, and what we in Texas refer to as kolaches: a sausage wrapped in dough, usually with cheese. https://www.schlotzskys.com/ # 6 Schlotzskys: 388 Locations Schlotzsky's was founded in Austin in the early 1970s and is known for its sandwiches prepared on that pillowy and deliciously chewy soda bread. They also have a great selection of pizzas, wraps, and soups. https://www.dickeys.com/ #5 Dickey's Barbeque Pit: 550 Locations Dickey's orginal location, founded in Dallas, Texas is still in operation- since 1941! Dickey's is known for their pit barbeque and incredible sides (the mac and cheese- yum!). Interestingly, Dickies has locations in Japan, the United Arab Emirates, and Singapore. https://whataburger.com/home #4 Whataburger: 940 Locations Texans' favorite burger brand (or should I say burger way of life ?) began in Corpus Christi. In 2001 a Texas bill declared Whataburger a "Texas Treasure." It's great burgers with the option to go even more "Texas" with toppings like green chili- or you can get Texas-style cream gravy with your chicken fingers. https://www.churchs.com/ #3 Church's Chicken: 1500 Locations Church's Chicken (known outside of Texas as Church's Texas Chicken or Texas Chicken) was founded in San Antonio. Known for, of course, fried chicken and fried seafood favorites (particularly during Lent). Church's is truly global, with locations as far away from Texas as New Zealand, England, Vietnam, and many more. https://chilis.com/ #2 Chili's: 1580 Locations Chili's seems to be in every single American town, but the very first opened in Dallas, Texas in 1975. This informal, but full-service, restaurant is known for Amercian favorites, including those baby-back-baby-back-baby-back ribs we've all sung the song about. Chili's exist on 6 continents with locations as diverse as Germany and Egypt. https://www.wingstop.com/ #1 Wing Stop: 1977 Locations The king of Texas food chains is Wing Stop, with nearly 2000 locations. Wing Stop began in Garland, Texas. Now, it seems that nearly every shopping center has a Wing Stop tossing wings in a variety of sauces.
